text:
maria: Support ticket #12345 — AcmeAnalytics hit per-org rate limits during a big eval, asking for a 2-hour unblock. They say its affecting a demo tomorrow. Can infra manually whitelist them for a short window?

devon: Do we have their org ID and which limit triggered (qps, tokens/sec, burst)?

maria: org: org_aca_77, triggered: per-org QPS (100req/s) and token burst cap. Support says their traffic is legitimate and limited to a single IP range.

kevin: For short-term relief we have two options: (1) temporary per-org whitelist (bypass enforcement) for a TTL, or (2) bump their per-org burst quota (safe delta). I prefer (2) to avoid bypassing checks entirely.

sarah: +1 to bumping burst. Bypass opens a path that could be abused if someone leaks the org key. Also easier for auditing if we change a quota value.

maria: The customer asked for a simple unblock; support asked for "whitelist" wording. My thought: do a controlled burst bump to 400req/s for 2 hours and tag it to ticket #12345.

devon: Agree. Implementation note: we need an API call to change per-org quota with expiry so this is reversible/traceable. Current admin UI only supports permanent quota edits. We should use the admin override endpoint:

```
POST /internal/admin/overrides
{
  "org_id": "org_aca_77",
  "quota_key": "per_org_qps",
  "value": 400,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-18T15:30:00Z",
  "reason": "Support ticket #12345 - temporary demo bump",
  "actor": "maria"
}
```

kevin: That endpoint is available but not surfaced in console. If we do this often, we should add a "temporary raises" workflow in the Console with audit + TTL + approval flow. For now I'll run the override and log the change.

maria: Can you also restrict by source IP range? Support provided range 34.201.0.0/16. If we can constrain to IPs that reduces risk.

devon: We don't enforce IP constraints at quota layer today; we could add a short-lived allowlist entry in the routing gateway to accept higher QPS from that IP range. But tying that to org overrides is extra work. Given time, schedule: do the quota override + note well follow up with Console change.

kevin: Performing override now. Will post the audit entry and notify support.

quota-bot: override applied: org=org_aca_77, quota=per_org_qps, old=100, new=400, expires=1772001578, by=kevin, ticket=#12345

support-bot: Notified customer. Ticket #12345 updated with override details and ETA.

maria: Thanks. Filed a GH issue to add a minimal "temp-raise" flow in Console and an approval step for >300% bumps. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/874

sarah: Small follow-up: devon/kevin can you add a monitoring alert that watches for unusual post-override traffic? If their demo sends a flood we want auto-throttle.

kevin: I'll add a short-lived alert rule scoped to org_aca_77 and the new limit. If traffic goes >500req/s for 1m, trigger paging to oncall.

maria: SGTM. Closing the loop — support will mark ticket resolved after the demo. If anything goes sideways, reopen and we'll revert immediately. :white_check_mark:
